name: procedural-bot-animations
description: A procedural animation engine for 2D SVG mascots: lively eyes (saccades, pursuit, blinks, eyelids), blended moods, reactions and activities, sprung and bending parts. Characters and animations are plain JSON. Includes a state machine and a scroll traveler.

scripts.site: npm run build && rm -rf site/dist site/docs && cp -r dist site/dist && mkdir -p site/docs && cp docs/character-format.md docs/animation-format.md site/docs/
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build

author: Jp-mainieri
